overview: Native gamepad support for Minecraft Java: analog movement, stick camera, and menu navigation that steps between real slots and buttons instead of shoving a pointer at them.
Client-side only. The server neither needs it nor knows about it.

1.1.4: Holding the stick forward sprints without the view pulsing: vanilla used to end the sprint on every bump and every bob above water, so the wider view flickered all the way up a hill.
Sneak moves to the stick click, and B opens chat with the pointer already on the newest link, so accepting a teleport is B then A. Button hints name the buttons printed on your own pad.
1.1.3: Presses stop landing where they should not: a button held over from a closing screen no longer jumps or sneaks, B and Start close only what Escape would, Y closes the inventory it opened, and a press just after a screen opens over the world is ignored.
Stick click actually sprints now, an offhand rod reels, the shoulders scroll a list rather than the slot under the cursor, and triggers let go a little below where they press.
1.1.0: The left trigger reels a fish by how far it is pulled.
1.0.1: Analog movement, stick camera and menu navigation that snaps to the slot or button you meant, d-pad keybinds, and boat steering that answers to how far the stick is pushed instead of turning as hard as it can every time.
